major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it alongside Shadow Dance whenever you have a Dance charge ready, and delay your Secret Technique and Shadow Dance slightly if Shadow Blades is about to come off cooldown so they line up together.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 121471 is the cast id and also the self aura; 279043 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Goremaw's Bite
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown right before or during Shadow Dance so it helps trigger Ancient Arts, and dump the last charge before the fight ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 426591 is the cast id; 426592 and 426593 share the name with no observed casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it on cooldown while on low combo points to re-enter Stealth for a free Shadowstrike, and use it to reset Deathstalker's Mark stacks when a Quietus Celeris proc knocks your cooldowns out of alignment.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1856 is the cast id; 11327 is the matching self aura. Base cooldown is not listed in the ability table; 120s is the standard Vanish cooldown.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to shed and become immune to magic damage and harmful magic effects.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use it against sustained physical or melee damage you cannot avoid by moving.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to heal yourself when you have taken damage and can spare the energy.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it ahead of raid-wide or area damage so the reduction is already active when the hit lands.

rules.description: Open with Shadowstrike into Vanish, Dance, and Blades
rules.action: Open from Stealth with Shadowstrike, Vanish back into Stealth for a second Shadowstrike, fire Goremaw's Bite, then chain Shadow Dance into Shadow Blades and lead the window with Secret Technique.

rules.description: Hold Secret Technique and Dance for Shadow Blades
rules.action: When Shadow Blades is about to come off cooldown, delay your next Secret Technique and Shadow Dance slightly so both land together with it.

rules.description: Secret Technique only inside Shadow Dance
rules.action: Save Secret Technique for Shadow Dance and fire it as your first finisher in the window.

rules.description: Goremaw's Bite only inside Shadow Dance
rules.action: Save Goremaw's Bite and use it as soon as Shadow Dance goes up to help trigger Ancient Arts.

rules.description: Shadowstrike, not Backstab, inside Shadow Dance
rules.action: Build with Shadowstrike while Shadow Dance is up and switch to Backstab outside it.

rules.description: Black Powder as the multi-target finisher
rules.action: Switch your finisher to Black Powder once several targets are up and keep Eviscerate for single target.
